name: js-cookie
instruction: Implement parseCookie.js (CommonJS): module.exports = parseCookie. parseCookie(header) parses a Cookie request header into a plain object. Pairs are separated by ';', and the FIRST '=' splits name from value. Names and values are trimmed. A value wrapped in double quotes has the quotes removed. Values are URL-decoded, but a value with a malformed percent escape is kept verbatim rather than throwing. When a name repeats, the FIRST occurrence wins. A segment with no '=' is skipped, as is an empty name. A non-string or empty header returns {}.
